bool member(string[] words, string text)
    for word := words[]
        if word == text
            return true
    return false

bool all_chars(string text, string alphabet)
    for: i < #text
        if not alphabet.contains(text[i])
            return false
    return true

string letters()
    return "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"

string unreserved()
    return letters() + "-._~"

string ascii()
    return " !{DQ}#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{{|}}~"

string lower(string text)
    result := ""
    for: i < #text
        match "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".find(text[i])
            nat index
                result += "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"[index]
            none
                result += text[i]
    return result

string trim(string text)
    nat start := 0
    end := #text
    while start < end and text[start] == " "
        start += 1
    while end > start and text[end - 1] == " "
        end -= 1
    return text[start:<end]

nat find_at(string text, string needle, nat at := 0)
    match text[at:].find(needle)
        nat found
            return at + found
        none
            return #text

string get(map<string, string> values, string key)
    match values.get(key)
        string value
            return value
        none
            return ""

bool valid_name(string text)
    return #text >= 1 and #text <= 20 and all_chars(text[0], "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz") and all_chars(text, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_")

bool valid_role(string text)
    return #text >= 1 and #text <= 16 and all_chars(text, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz")

bool valid_segment(string text)
    return text != "" and text != "." and text != ".." and all_chars(text, unreserved())

bool canonical(string path)
    if path == "/"
        return true
    if not path.starts_with("/")
        return false
    for part := path[1:].split("/")[]
        if not valid_segment(part)
            return false
    return true

bool media(string text)
    parts := text.split("/")
    return #parts == 2 and parts[0] != "" and parts[1] != "" and all_chars(parts[0] + parts[1], "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789.+-")

bool decimal(string text, int low, int high)
    if text == "" or not all_chars(text, "0123456789") or (#text > 1 and text[0] == "0")
        return false
    value := int(text)
    return value >= low and value <= high

string hex(int value, nat width, upper := true)
    if width <= 0
        return ""
    low := nat(value % 16 ^ width)
    digits := if upper then low.B16 else low.b16
    return "0" * (width - #digits) + digits

int hex_value(string text)
    value := 0
    for: i < #text
        match "0123456789abcdef".find(lower(text[i]))
            nat index
                value = value * 16 + int(index)
            none
                return -1
    return value

string decode(string text)
    result := ""
    nat at := 0
    while at < #text
        if text[at] == "%"
            result += ascii()[hex_value(text[at + 1:<at + 3]) - 32]
            at += 3
        else
            result += text[at]
            at += 1
    return result

string encode(string text)
    result := ""
    for: i < #text
        result += if unreserved().contains(text[i]) then text[i] else "%" + hex(text[i].codepoints()[0], 2)
    return result

class Pair(string name, string value)

string encoded(Pair[] pairs)
    return [for pair := pairs[] then encode(pair.name) + "=" + encode(pair.value)].join("&")

string json_string(string text)
    return DQ + text.split("\").join("\\").split(DQ).join("\" + DQ) + DQ

string json_object(Pair[] pairs)
    return "{{" + [for pair := pairs[] then json_string(pair.name) + ":" + json_string(pair.value)].join(",") + "}}"

string html(string text)
    return text.split("&").join("&").split("<").join("<").split(">").join(">").split(DQ).join(""")

class Piece(string kind, string name)

Piece[] | error parse_pattern(string text)
    if not text.starts_with("/")
        return error("bad pattern {text}")
    if text == "/"
        return []
    Piece[] pieces := []
    string[] names := []
    fields := text[1:].split("/")
    for: field := fields[i]
        if valid_segment(field)
            pieces = pieces.append(Piece("literal", field))
            continue
        if not field.starts_with("{{") or not field.ends_with("}}")
            return error("bad pattern {text}")
        content := field[1:<#field - 1]
        kind := "untyped"
        name := content
        if content.starts_with("*")
            kind = "wildcard"
            name = content[1:]
            if i + 1 != #fields
                return error("bad pattern {text}")
        elif content.contains(":")
            parts := content.split(":")
            if #parts != 2 or (parts[1] != "int" and parts[1] != "slug")
                return error("bad pattern {text}")
            name = parts[0]
            kind = parts[1]
        if not valid_name(name) or member(names, name)
            return error("bad pattern {text}")
        names = names.append(name)
        pieces = pieces.append(Piece(kind, name))
    return pieces

bool fits(Piece piece, string text)
    if piece.kind == "literal"
        return text == piece.name
    if piece.kind == "int"
        return #text >= 1 and #text <= 9 and all_chars(text, "0123456789")
    if piece.kind == "slug"
        return text != "" and all_chars(text, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-")
    return true

class Route(string name, string[] methods, string pattern, Piece[] pieces, string role)
    string[] types := []
    selections := 0

    bool wildcard()
        return #pieces > 0 and pieces[-1].kind == "wildcard"

    bool matches(string[] segments)
        nat fixed := #pieces - (if wildcard() then 1 else 0)
        if #segments < fixed or (not wildcard() and #segments != fixed)
            return false
        for: i < fixed
            if not fits(pieces[i], segments[i])
                return false
        return true

class Redirect(string from, string base, string target, bool prefix, int code)
class Client(string name, int level, int timestamp)
    allowed := 0
    limited := 0
class Response(int status, body := "")
    headers := map<string, string>()
    type := "text/plain"
    show_body := true

Response redirect(int code, string destination)
    response := Response(code, "redirect to {destination}")
    .response.headers.set("Location", destination)
    return response

string normalized(string path)
    decoded := ""
    nat at := 0
    while at < #path
        if path[at] == "%"
            code := hex_value(path[at + 1:<at + 3])
            ch := ascii()[code - 32]
            decoded += if unreserved().contains(ch) then ch else "%" + hex(code, 2)
            at += 3
        else
            decoded += path[at]
            at += 1
    string[] result := []
    for part := decoded[1:].split("/")[]
        if part == ".."
            if #result > 0
                result = result[:<#result - 1]
        elif part != "" and part != "."
            result = result.append(part)
    return "/" + result.join("/")

class Accept(string range, nat specificity, int weight)

int parse_weight(string text)
    parts := text.split(".")
    if #parts > 2 or (parts[0] != "0" and parts[0] != "1")
        return -1
    fraction := if #parts == 2 then parts[1] else ""
    if #fraction > 3 or not all_chars(fraction, if parts[0] == "1" then "0" else "0123456789")
        return -1
    return int(parts[0]) * 1000 + int(fraction + "0" * (3 - #fraction))

string negotiate(string[] types, map<string, string> headers)
    if not headers.has("accept")
        return types[0]
    Accept[] elements := []
    for element := get(headers, "accept").split(",")[]
        parts := element.split(";")
        range := lower(trim(parts[0]))
        fields := range.split("/")
        nat specificity := if range == "*/*" then 1 elif #fields == 2 and fields[1] == "*" and fields[0] != "" and all_chars(fields[0], "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789.+-") then 2 elif media(range) then 3 else 0
        w := 1000
        for: 1 <= i < #parts
            equal := find_at(parts[i], "=")
            if equal < #parts[i] and lower(trim(parts[i][:<equal])) == "q"
                w = parse_weight(trim(parts[i][equal + 1:]))
                break
        if specificity > 0 and w >= 0
            elements = elements.append(Accept(range, specificity, w))
    selected := ""
    best_weight := 0
    for type := types[]
        nat specificity := 0
        w := 0
        for element := elements[]
            fitting := element.range == "*/*" or element.range == type or (element.range.ends_with("/*") and type.starts_with(element.range[:<#element.range - 1]))
            if fitting and element.specificity > specificity
                specificity = element.specificity
                w = element.weight
        if w > best_weight
            best_weight = w
            selected = type
    return selected

Pair[] sorted_pairs(Pair[] pairs)
    Pair[] result := []
    keys := [for pair := pairs[] then pair.name].sorted()
    for key := keys[]
        for pair := pairs[]
            if pair.name == key
                result = result.append(pair)
    return result

string render_body(string type, string name, Pair[] params, Pair[] query, Pair[] cookies)
    if type == "application/json"
        items := [for pair := query[] then "[" + json_string(pair.name) + "," + json_string(pair.value) + "]"].join(",")
        return "{{{DQ}route{DQ}:" + json_string(name) + ",{DQ}params{DQ}:" + json_object(params) + ",{DQ}query{DQ}:[" + items + "],{DQ}cookies{DQ}:" + json_object(cookies) + "}}"
    if type == "text/html"
        result := "<dl><dt>route</dt><dd>{html(name)}</dd>"
        for pair := params[]
            result += "<dt>param {html(pair.name)}</dt><dd>{html(pair.value)}</dd>"
        for pair := query[]
            result += "<dt>query {html(pair.name)}</dt><dd>{html(pair.value)}</dd>"
        for pair := cookies[]
            result += "<dt>cookie {html(pair.name)}</dt><dd>{html(pair.value)}</dd>"
        return result + "</dl>"
    return "route={name} params=" + (if #params == 0 then "-" else encoded(params)) + " query=" + (if #query == 0 then "-" else encoded(query)) + " cookies=" + (if #cookies == 0 then "-" else encoded(cookies))

string etag(string body)
    a := 1
    b := 0
    for code := body.codepoints()[]
        a = (a + code) % 65521
        b = (b + a) % 65521
    return DQ + hex(b, 4, false) + hex(a, 4, false) + DQ

class Router()
    Route[] routes := []
    nat[] ranked := []
    tokens := map<string, string>()
    Redirect[] redirects := []
    string[] origins := []
    capacity := 0
    period := 0
    Client[] clients := []
    errors := 0
    requests := 0
    url_ok := 0
    url_errors := 0
    statuses := array(502, fill = 0)

    int route_id(string name)
        for: route := routes[i]
            if route.name == name
                return int(i)
        return -1

    bool higher(nat left, nat right)
        literals := 0
        typed := 0
        for piece := routes[left].pieces[]
            if piece.kind == "literal"
                literals += 1
            elif piece.kind == "int" or piece.kind == "slug"
                typed += 1
        for piece := routes[right].pieces[]
            if piece.kind == "literal"
                literals -= 1
            elif piece.kind == "int" or piece.kind == "slug"
                typed -= 1
        return if literals != 0 then literals > 0 elif typed != 0 then typed > 0 elif routes[left].wildcard() != routes[right].wildcard() then not routes[left].wildcard() else left < right

    void | error .configure(string line)
        words := line.split(" ")
        cmd := words[0]
        args := words[1:]
        count := #args
        if not member(["ROUTE", "TOKEN", "REDIRECT", "ORIGIN", "LIMIT", "TYPES"], cmd)
            return error("unknown command {cmd}")
        valid_count := if cmd == "ROUTE" then count == 3 or count == 5 elif cmd == "TOKEN" or cmd == "LIMIT" then count == 2 elif cmd == "REDIRECT" then count == 3 elif cmd == "ORIGIN" then count == 1 else count >= 2
        if not valid_count
            return error("wrong number of arguments")
        if cmd == "ROUTE"
            name := args[0]
            if not valid_name(name)
                return error("bad route name {name}")
            if route_id(name) >= 0
                return error("duplicate route {name}")
            methods := args[1].split(",")
            string[] seen := []
            for method := methods[]
                if not member(["GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"], method) or member(seen, method)
                    return error("bad methods {args[1]}")
                seen = seen.append(method)
            pieces := try parse_pattern(args[2])
            role := "none"
            if count == 5
                if args[3] != "ROLE"
                    return error("unknown option {args[3]}")
                if not valid_role(args[4])
                    return error("bad role {args[4]}")
                role = args[4]
            routes = routes.append(Route(name, methods, args[2], pieces, role))
        elif cmd == "TOKEN"
            if #args[0] < 1 or #args[0] > 32 or not all_chars(args[0], letters() + "._-")
                return error("bad token {args[0]}")
            if tokens.has(args[0])
                return error("duplicate token {args[0]}")
            if not valid_role(args[1])
                return error("bad role {args[1]}")
            .tokens.set(args[0], args[1])
        elif cmd == "REDIRECT"
            string[] bases := []
            bool[] prefixes := []
            for: nat i < 2
                prefix := args[i].ends_with("/*")
                base := if prefix then args[i][:<#args[i] - 2] else args[i]
                if not canonical(base) or (prefix and base == "/")
                    return error("bad path {args[i]}")
                bases = bases.append(base)
                prefixes = prefixes.append(prefix)
            if prefixes[0] != prefixes[1]
                return error("wildcard mismatch")
            if not member(["301", "302", "307", "308"], args[2])
                return error("bad redirect code {args[2]}")
            for rule := redirects[]
                if rule.from == args[0]
                    return error("duplicate redirect {args[0]}")
            redirects = redirects.append(Redirect(args[0], bases[0], bases[1], prefixes[0], int(args[2])))
        elif cmd == "ORIGIN"
            origin := args[0]
            start := if origin.starts_with("http://") then 7 elif origin.starts_with("https://") then 8 else #origin
            if start == #origin or not all_chars(origin[start:], "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789.:-")
                return error("bad origin {origin}")
            if member(origins, origin)
                return error("duplicate origin {origin}")
            origins = origins.append(origin)
        elif cmd == "LIMIT"
            if not decimal(args[0], 1, 100) or not decimal(args[1], 1, 3600)
                return error("bad limit")
            if capacity > 0
                return error("duplicate limit")
            capacity = int(args[0])
            period = int(args[1])
        else
            int id := route_id(args[0])
            if id < 0
                return error("unknown route {args[0]}")
            if #routes[id].types > 0
                return error("duplicate types {args[0]}")
            string[] types := []
            for: 1 <= i < count
                if not media(args[i])
                    return error("bad media type {args[i]}")
                if member(types, args[i])
                    return error("duplicate media type {args[i]}")
                types = types.append(args[i])
            routes[id].types = types
        return void

    void .finish()
        limit := if capacity == 0 then "none" else "{capacity}/{period}"
        println("CONFIG routes={#routes} tokens={tokens.size()} redirects={#redirects} origins={#origins} limit={limit} errors={errors}")
        for: i < #routes
            if #routes[i].types == 0
                routes[i].types = ["application/json"]
            nat at := 0
            while at < #ranked and not higher(i, ranked[at])
                at += 1
            ranked = ranked[:<at].append(i).concat(ranked[at:])
        for: id := ranked[i]
            route := routes[id]
            methods := route.methods
            if member(methods, "GET")
                methods = methods.append("HEAD")
            role := if route.role == "none" then "-" else route.role
            println("TABLE {i + 1} {route.name} {methods.sorted().join(",")} {route.pattern} role={role} types={route.types.join(",")}")

    Response .route_request(string method, string path, string query, bool has_query, map<string, string> headers)
        string[] segments := if path == "/" then [] else path[1:].split("/")
        nat[] matching := []
        allowed := ["OPTIONS"]
        for id := ranked[]
            if routes[id].matches(segments)
                matching = matching.append(id)
                for candidate := routes[id].methods[]
                    if not member(allowed, candidate)
                        allowed = allowed.append(candidate)
        if #matching == 0
            return Response(404, "not found: {path}")
        if member(allowed, "GET")
            allowed = allowed.append("HEAD")
        allow := allowed.sorted().join(", ")
        if method == "OPTIONS"
            response := Response(204)
            .response.headers.set("Allow", allow)
            return response
        lookup := if method == "HEAD" then "GET" else method
        selected := -1
        for id := matching[]
            if member(routes[id].methods, lookup)
                selected = int(id)
                break
        if selected < 0
            response := Response(405, "method not allowed: {method}")
            .response.headers.set("Allow", allow)
            return response
        routes[selected].selections += 1
        route := routes[selected]
        if route.role != "none"
            if not headers.has("authorization")
                response := Response(401, "unauthorized: missing token")
                .response.headers.set("WWW-Authenticate", "Bearer realm={DQ}api{DQ}")
                return response
            auth := get(headers, "authorization")
            space := find_at(auth, " ")
            token := if space < #auth then auth[space + 1:] else ""
            if lower(auth[:<space]) != "bearer" or not tokens.has(token)
                response := Response(401, "unauthorized: invalid token")
                .response.headers.set("WWW-Authenticate", "Bearer realm={DQ}api{DQ}, error={DQ}invalid_token{DQ}")
                return response
            role := get(tokens, token)
            if role != route.role and role != "admin"
                return Response(403, "forbidden: requires role {route.role}")
        response := Response(200)
        if #route.types > 1
            .response.headers.set("Vary", "Accept")
        type := negotiate(route.types, headers)
        if type == ""
            response.status = 406
            response.body = "not acceptable: {route.types.join(", ")}"
            return response
        Pair[] params := []
        for: piece := route.pieces[i]
            if piece.kind == "literal"
                continue
            value := ""
            if piece.kind == "wildcard"
                value = [for segment := segments[i:][] then decode(segment)].join("/")
            elif piece.kind == "int"
                value = string(int(segments[i]))
            else
                value = if piece.kind == "untyped" then decode(segments[i]) else segments[i]
            params = params.append(Pair(piece.name, value))
        Pair[] queries := []
        if has_query
            for part := query.split("&")[]
                if part == ""
                    continue
                equal := find_at(part, "=")
                name := part[:<equal]
                value := if equal < #part then part[equal + 1:] else ""
                queries = queries.append(Pair(decode(name.split("+").join(" ")), decode(value.split("+").join(" "))))
        Pair[] cookies := []
        string[] cookie_names := []
        for raw := get(headers, "cookie").split(";")[]
            part := trim(raw)
            equal := find_at(part, "=")
            name := part[:<equal]
            if equal < #part and name != "" and not member(cookie_names, name)
                cookies = cookies.append(Pair(name, part[equal + 1:]))
                cookie_names = cookie_names.append(name)
        body := render_body(type, route.name, sorted_pairs(params), queries, sorted_pairs(cookies))
        tag := etag(body)
        if headers.has("if-none-match")
            for raw := get(headers, "if-none-match").split(",")[]
                candidate := trim(raw)
                if candidate.starts_with("W/")
                    candidate = candidate[2:]
                if candidate == "*" or candidate == tag
                    if lookup == "GET"
                        response.status = 304
                        .response.headers.set("ETag", tag)
                    else
                        response.status = 412
                        response.body = "precondition failed: {tag}"
                    return response
        response.body = body
        response.type = type
        .response.headers.set("ETag", tag)
        return response

    Response .dispatch(string method, string target, map<string, string> headers)
        if not member(["GET", "HEAD", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"], method)
            return Response(501, "not implemented: {method}")
        if get(headers, "host") == ""
            return Response(400, "bad request: missing host")
        effective := method
        if headers.has("x-http-method-override")
            override := get(headers, "x-http-method-override")
            if method != "POST" or not member(["PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"], override)
                return Response(400, "bad request: method override")
            effective = override
        client := get(headers, "x-client")
        if client != ""
            timestamp := int(get(headers, "x-time"))
            id := #clients
            for: record := clients[i]
                if record.name == client
                    id = i
                    break
            if id == #clients
                clients = clients.append(Client(client, capacity * period, timestamp))
            wait := 0
            if capacity > 0
                level := clients[id].level + (timestamp - clients[id].timestamp) * capacity
                clients[id].level = if level > capacity * period then capacity * period else level
                clients[id].timestamp = timestamp
                if clients[id].level < period
                    wait = (period - clients[id].level + capacity - 1) / capacity
                else
                    clients[id].level -= period
            if wait > 0
                clients[id].limited += 1
                response := Response(429, "too many requests: client {client}")
                .response.headers.set("Retry-After", "{wait}")
                return response
            clients[id].allowed += 1
        question := find_at(target, "?")
        path := target[:<question]
        query := if question < #target then target[question + 1:] else ""
        suffix := if question < #target then "?" + query else ""
        normal := normalized(path)
        if normal != path
            return redirect(308, normal + suffix)
        for rule := redirects[]
            if path == rule.base or (rule.prefix and path.starts_with(rule.base + "/"))
                return redirect(rule.code, rule.target + path[#rule.base:] + suffix)
        return .route_request(effective, path, query, question < #target, headers)

    Response .respond(string line, string[] header_lines)
        parts := line.split(" ")
        if #parts != 3 or #parts[0] < 1 or #parts[0] > 16 or not all_chars(parts[0], "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ") or not parts[1].starts_with("/") or parts[1].contains("#") or parts[2] != "HTTP/1.1"
            return Response(400, "bad request: request line")
        method := parts[0]
        target := parts[1]
        show := method != "HEAD"
        for: i < #target
            if target[i] == "%"
                code := if i + 2 < #target then hex_value(target[i + 1:<i + 3]) else -1
                if code < 32 or code > 126
                    response := Response(400, "bad request: percent escape")
                    response.show_body = show
                    return response
        map<string, string> headers
        for: header := header_lines[i]
            colon := find_at(header, ":")
            name := lower(header[:<colon])
            message := ""
            if colon == #header or name == "" or not all_chars(name, letters() + "-")
                message = "bad request: header line {i + 1}"
            elif headers.has(name)
                message = "bad request: duplicate header {name}"
            if message != ""
                response := Response(400, message)
                response.show_body = show
                return response
            .headers.set(name, trim(header[colon + 1:]))
        Response response := .dispatch(method, target, headers)
        response.show_body = show
        origin := get(headers, "origin")
        if member(origins, origin)
            .response.headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", origin)
            if response.status == 204 and headers.has("access-control-request-method")
                .response.headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", get(response.headers, "Allow"))
        return response

    string | error build_url(string name, string[] arguments)
        int id := route_id(name)
        if id < 0
            return error("unknown route {name}")
        route := routes[id]
        names := [for piece := route.pieces[] if piece.kind != "literal" then piece.name]
        map<string, string> values
        Pair[] query := []
        for arg := arguments[]
            equal := find_at(arg, "=")
            key := arg[:<equal]
            if equal == #arg or key == ""
                return error("bad argument {arg}")
            value := arg[equal + 1:]
            if member(names, key)
                if values.has(key)
                    return error("duplicate parameter {key}")
                .values.set(key, value)
            else
                query = query.append(Pair(key, value))
        string[] segments := []
        for piece := route.pieces[]
            if piece.kind == "literal"
                segments = segments.append(piece.name)
                continue
            if not values.has(piece.name) and piece.kind != "wildcard"
                return error("missing parameter {piece.name}")
            value := get(values, piece.name)
            valid := true
            if piece.kind == "wildcard"
                if value != ""
                    for part := value.split("/")[]
                        if part == "" or part == "." or part == ".."
                            valid = false
            elif piece.kind == "untyped"
                valid = value != "" and value != "." and value != ".."
            else
                valid = fits(piece, value)
            if not valid
                return error("bad value for {piece.name}")
            if piece.kind == "wildcard"
                if value != ""
                    segments = segments.concat([for part := value.split("/")[] then encode(part)])
            else
                segments = segments.append(encode(value))
        return "/" + segments.join("/") + (if #query == 0 then "" else "?" + encoded(query))

string phrase(int status)
    if status == 200
        return "OK"
    if status == 204
        return "No Content"
    if status == 301
        return "Moved Permanently"
    if status == 302
        return "Found"
    if status == 304
        return "Not Modified"
    if status == 307
        return "Temporary Redirect"
    if status == 308
        return "Permanent Redirect"
    if status == 400
        return "Bad Request"
    if status == 401
        return "Unauthorized"
    if status == 403
        return "Forbidden"
    if status == 404
        return "Not Found"
    if status == 405
        return "Method Not Allowed"
    if status == 406
        return "Not Acceptable"
    if status == 412
        return "Precondition Failed"
    if status == 429
        return "Too Many Requests"
    return "Not Implemented"

router := Router()
nat line_number := 0
while true
    string line
    scan(&line)
    line_number += 1
    if line == "REQUESTS"
        break
    match .router.configure(line)
        void
            void
        error problem
            router.errors += 1
            println("CONFIG ERROR {line_number}: {problem.message}")
.router.finish()
while true
    string line
    scan(&line)
    if line == "END"
        break
    if line.starts_with("URLFOR ")
        words := line.split(" ")
        match router.build_url(words[1], words[2:])
            string url
                router.url_ok += 1
                println("URLFOR {words[1]} {url}")
            error problem
                router.url_errors += 1
                println("URLFOR ERROR {problem.message}")
        continue
    string[] headers := []
    while true
        string header
        scan(&header)
        if header == ""
            break
        headers = headers.append(header)
    response := .router.respond(line, headers)
    router.requests += 1
    router.statuses[response.status] += 1
    println("REQUEST {router.requests}{NL}HTTP/1.1 {response.status} {phrase(response.status)}")
    if response.status != 204 and response.status != 304
        .response.headers.set("Content-Type", response.type)
        .response.headers.set("Content-Length", "{#response.body}")
    for name := ["Location", "Allow", "Retry-After", "WWW-Authenticate", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "Vary", "ETag", "Content-Type", "Content-Length"][]
        if response.headers.has(name)
            println("{name}: {get(response.headers, name)}")
    if response.status != 204 and response.status != 304 and response.show_body
        println(response.body)
println("SUMMARY requests={router.requests} urlfor_ok={router.url_ok} urlfor_error={router.url_errors}")
for: status < 502
    if router.statuses[status] > 0
        println("STATUS {status} {router.statuses[status]}")
for route := router.routes[]
    println("ROUTE {route.name} {route.selections}")
client_names := [for client := router.clients[] then client.name].sorted()
for name := client_names[]
    for client := router.clients[]
        if client.name == name
            println("CLIENT {name} allowed={client.allowed} limited={client.limited}")
